about: Everyone in the realm (rules/dialogue.gd runs their talk). 'place' is a village (a 'village:' line in levels/world/) plus rows and columns from its square, or a land id and a row and column. 'look' is a picture in art/. 'role' (shop or smith) opens a shop or the forge. 'show_if' hides them until true. 'talk' is nodes: 'start' first; each node is a list of variants, the first whose 'if' all pass is used. 'say' pages, 'do' effects, 'choices', 'next'. Conditions: first_time, quest_new|quest_active|quest_done:ID, quest_step:ID:N, has:ITEM:N, stones:N, flag:NAME, not:... Effects: start_quest|advance_quest|finish_quest:ID, give|take:ITEM:N, set_flag:NAME, open:shop|forge, event:GOAL.

say: You came back. Most don't, the first time.
Then this is yours. The Dawnstone, first of the seven. Hold it high and the dark will remember what it fears.
Go north to the Weepingwold. Old Mother Wenna has kept the second secret longer than I have been alive.
So. You are the one the fires chose, {hero}.
I am Maera, Warden of Emberhold. Every night the Shadow King drinks more of our light, and soon there will be none left to drink.
Seven Light Stones can seal the Shadowgate. I keep the first. But I will not hand it to someone who has never faced the dark.
There is a Mine below the village. Go down. Walk out again. Then we will talk.
The Mine waits below the village, {hero}. The dark will not come up to meet you.
Keep your lantern lit, {hero}.
Ask what you must.

choices.text: How do I mend my wounds?

say: Strike your foes and your lantern drinks their light: that is Lumen.
Stand still, hold Q, and it will close a wound. Take a blow while you do it and the light is wasted.
You will wake at the last lantern you touched. Your gold stays where you fell, glowing: a Lost Light.
Reach it and the gold is yours again. Fall a second time first, and the dark keeps it.
Sun ore. Three pieces, still warm. You went deep for this.
Take this sigil. My father cut it; I never earned it. You have.
The fire's hot. What do you want, {hero}?
Speak.
The forge starves. Sun ore lies in the deep places, where the light used to pool.
Bring me three pieces and I will give you something worth more than gold.
Gold for goods, goods for gold. The dark is bad for trade, so I don't haggle.
You found Ash? He's alive?
...Thank you. Take this. I found it in the old well and I don't know what it is, but it glows like you do.
Ash ran into the Weepingwold when the howling started. He's grey with one white ear.
Ash won't leave my side now. Neither of us goes near the trees.
My hound ran off into the Weepingwold three nights ago. Everyone says he's gone. Will you look?
The grey hound whines, thin and shaking, and limps to your side. He will find his own way home now.
The thorns have stopped whispering your name. That means they accept you.
Take the Thornheart. Walls will not hold you now. South lies the Drowned Mere; Corran the Ferryman knows its depths.
The Warden sent you. I heard your boots a mile off.
The Thornheart sleeps in roots older than Emberhold, and the wood will not give it to a stranger.
Cut down what hunts here. Climb the watchtower and look on the wold. Then come back and we will see.
The wold is watching you, {hero}. It has not decided yet.
Go on. The trees remember you kindly.
You do not have the smell of the Warden's errand on you yet. Come back when you do.
You came up. And you are holding it.
Keep the Pearl and the water will carry you. North, in Hollowcrown, the last knight still keeps his watch.
A whole village sank under this water once. The Drowned Pearl went down with it.
There is a Mine below the shore where the old roads lead. Find its bottom and come back breathing.
The Mine on the shore, {hero}. The water is patient. Be quicker than it.
The Mere is calmer since you came. I sleep, sometimes.
No passage today. The water is wrong.
It is done. They are quiet.
Wear the Crown's strength, not the Crown. Break what bars your way. In the Wintermarch, find Hrefna.
I was the Hollow Guard. All of it, now. The others walk these halls still, but not as men.
Lay three of them to rest. They deserve that much. Then the Crown of Ash is yours.
Three of my brothers, {hero}. Be quick. They feel nothing, but I do.
I keep my watch. Someone must.
Turn back, wanderer. These halls are not for the living.
Under the snow, where they circled: the Wintermark. You'll leap like the storm with it.
The Cinder Wastes are past the Ashen Gate, and the Gate only opens for one who carries five stones.
You're the one with the stones. Good. The wolves have grown bold since the light failed.
Bring down three. Then climb a watchtower and see what they have been circling.
The wolves, {hero}. And the tower. The cold won't wait for you.
Hunting's better now. Thanks to you.
Not now. I'm tracking.
Your hands aren't even burned. The Ember chose you.
One stone left. Morwen, in the Mirefen, has been waiting a long time for you.
The Gate let you through. Then you carry five of the seven.
The Sunforge Ember burns at the bottom of the Mine beneath the Wastes. It burned the last three who went for it.
The Mine beneath the Wastes. Drink before you go.
The well is full again. First time in nine years.
The Ashen Gate is shut to you, stranger.
The Ravenmoon. Look through it and the hidden ways will show themselves.
Seven stones. Go to the Shadowgate. What waits beyond it has waited a hundred years for you.
I dreamed of you. Twice. In the second dream you won.
The lurkers in the black water have the Ravenmoon's scent. Drive off three and it will surface.
Three lurkers, {hero}. The fen does not forgive slowness.
Go. I will not dream of you again until it is over.
Not yet, child. Not yet.
